But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Geshur
people.line: Aramean kingdom; Talmai's domain; refuge for Absalom

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: So Joab got up, went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.
